title: GSE Coach-Brain LLM & Engine - Copy
universal_lens: Games are stochastic processes governed by latent coach strategies; sportsbooks regressively price outcomes using narrow Gaussian approximations, distorting true marginal distributions. Empirical Bayes skill shrinkage and probabilistic HMM pass-blocking models form a unified framework for dynamic decision-making under uncertainty.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs conformal prediction and Bayesian updating to infer latent game states from noisy bookmaker signals, correcting for systematic biases in line-setting models. GSI employs Bayesian shrinkage for player skill estimation and conformal prediction for decision confidence intervals, enabling robust inference over uncertain game states.
gse_mapping: GSE executes state transitions via sealed Coach-First architecture, where simulation engines condition on verified coach mindsets and temporal invariants to generate actionable play-calling strategies. GSE leverages HMM-based spatial assignments and causal forecasting modules to model real-time situational awareness and transition dynamics in play execution.

primitives.name: Coach-First Doctrine
primitives.verbatim_quote: To enforce this Coach-First doctrine in code, the GSE Coach-Mind v2.0 architecture partitions execution into three strict zones separated by a compile-time AST and runtime firewall (apps/web/lib/fences/no-book-in-coach-engine-fence.ts)2.
primitives.assumptions: Execution must be partitioned to prevent feedback loops between external bookmaker data and internal coach decision logic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Code-level architectural separation enforcing data flow integrity.

layer2.mapping: The three-zone structure mirrors a causal inference framework where external inputs are filtered through a sealed internal model before generating outputs.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of AST and firewall integrity via Merkle root checks.

primitives.name: Entropy-Regularized Optimal Transport
primitives.verbatim_quote: Mid-week injury updates (v2.0 Wednesday practice reports through v4.0 Sunday T-90m official inactives) may only reallocate target and carry weights via entropy-regularized Sinkhorn-Knopp optimal transport under the fixed cost matrix and multiply by pre-sealed EPA dropoff multipliers5.
primitives.assumptions: Injury impact can be modeled as a transport problem with fixed costs and entropy regularization to maintain probabilistic consistency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Dynamic weight reallocation under uncertainty constraints.

layer2.mapping: Optimal transport provides a principled method for adjusting player allocation based on injury data while preserving expected value integrity.
layer2.telemetry: Consistency of EPA dropoff multipliers post-injury update.

primitives.name: Gaussian Line Pricing Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: Sportsbooks price NFL slates from the top down—setting a coarse team-rating mean (μ), reading 12 to 47 alternate rungs off a static Gaussian cumulative distribution function with an artificially narrow margin standard deviation (σ = 12.07 at BetMGM, 12.21 at Pinnacle, and 13.16 at DraftKings vs.
primitives.assumptions: Bookmakers use static Gaussian distributions to approximate outcome probabilities, introducing bias due to narrow variance estimates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Static probabilistic approximation of game margins.

layer2.mapping: Models the discrepancy between actual NFL margin variance and bookmaker-imposed variance as a form of systematic noise in pricing.
layer2.telemetry: Comparison of σ values between bookmaker models and empirical NFL data.

primitives.name: Sealed Coach Projection Receipt

primitives.breakdown_regime: Pre-computation input sanitization and cryptographic sealing.

layer2.mapping: The receipt mechanism enforces a cryptographic commitment to the internal state, analogous to a Bayesian posterior update with fixed priors.
